error[ZBX-E0227]: a CDI device needs an edit zbx does not apply
  cause  its spec has a hook other than nvidia-cdi-hook update-ldcache
  fix    ask a device that needs only device nodes, mounts, environment variables and nvidia-cdi-hook update-ldcache, or pass the node as a path:   zbx run --device /dev/nvidia0 <image>
  more   zbx explain E0227 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0227.html
